rules: Keep distinct Telegram signal events for timing evaluation.
Count one business capture per token at its earliest legal captured event.
Do not let later ATH events claim a token already captured by an earlier legal event.
Report event and unique-token recall and precision together.

wick_tier.note: A transient high is not assumed executable.

sustained_tier.note: Requires the canonical sustained-price rule and a time-legal baseline.

executable_tier.note: Requires executable buy and exit quotes at the configured size; never infer from wick or OHLCV high.

right_censoring.rule: A signal is excluded from a horizon denominator until signal_ts + horizon_sec <= snapshot_ts.

earliest_legal_capture.selection_rule: For each token, choose the earliest event satisfying every required condition; break exact timestamp ties by canonical signal identity.
earliest_legal_capture.later_event_rule: Later ATH or lifecycle events remain timing evidence but cannot add another unique-token capture.
